title: Skill-check menu lines are inconsistent about telegraphing failure cost: some explicitly say 'a miss costs standing with X', some say 'a hit costs standing', some (e.g. digging at the Avalanche Field) show no cost for failure at all beyond flavor text, making real risk hard to judge at a glance.

evidence.quote: Skill-check menu lines are inconsistent about telegraphing failure cost: some explicitly say 'a miss costs standing with X', some say 'a hit costs standing', some (e.g. digging at the Avalanche Field) show no cost for failure at all beyond flavor text, making real risk hard to judge at a glance.
